scope: Apparel Cart failure correction and promotion/checkout acceptance in one batch

readinessAndOwnership.mode: Framework-maintainer correction plus authorized native Local acceptance
readinessAndOwnership.businessOutcome: Return an actionable Cart business rejection, then qualify the existing Apparel promotion and checkout journey without manufacturing operational state.
readinessAndOwnership.layer: Existing Cart operation service and Cart status definitions
studied: nSetup coding, role and customer-project contracts
Promotion activated consumption, issuance and secure reveal
Checkout payment selection and offline provider contract
readinessAndOwnership.scopeReview: PASS: Cart owns response validation errors. Existing HTTP resources, permissions, tenant/customer ownership, persisted Store and owner ports are unchanged. No stock, campaign, coupon, grant, provider qualification or runtime configuration was written to bypass a prerequisite. Pre-existing unrelated worktree changes were preserved.
readinessAndOwnership.customization: Later-loaded validation overrides retain typed stock-only rejection, other-validation rejection, owner-fault propagation and no-calculation-on-block boundaries. Independent partner fixtures exercise this contract.

point1.cause: Entry-response validation threw an ordinary Error when Inventory validation blocked the Cart. The calculation engine already used a typed stock rejection, but the earlier response-validation branch produced HTTP 500.
point1.correction: Stock-only blocking reasons now use ERR_CART_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE (409); other/mixed blocking validation uses ERR_CART_VALIDATION_FAILED (422). Owner read errors propagate unchanged and blocked validation does not calculate.
point1.rollbackLimit: Entry mutation precedes response validation. A rejected response is not transaction rollback; the live test read the persisted entry and removed its own rejected entry through the Cart API.

point2.execution: Explicit execute with two existing imported customer fixtures kept in memory; signup was not bypassed or requalified.

operationalInspection.authority: Normal authenticated Commerce schema capabilities and exact-filter safe-search APIs; budget-ledger read through Promotion
operationalInspection.limit: Empty read results do not authorize inserting opening stock or asserting reconciled zero consumption.

requiredOwnerWork.gap: RECEIVE requires an existing balance. No first-receipt/opening-balance operation exists, and operational stock snapshot imports are explicitly rejected.
requiredOwnerWork.requiredEvidence: Approved intake provenance and quantities, Inventory-owned first receipt, atomic/replay-safe balance and movement evidence, and absence/conflict/recovery tests. Do not insert a balance through generic CRUD.

requiredOwnerWork.gap: Activated policy retains budget.limit but requires an existing operational budget.spent. There is no evidenced first-use consumption admission operation.
requiredOwnerWork.requiredEvidence: Owner-reviewed new-campaign or reconciled opening-consumption semantics, retained policy/scope binding, ledger/redemption checks, replay/conflict evidence. A legacy draft write with spent=0 is not that evidence.

requiredOwnerWork.gap: Generated coupon batch issuance stores token hashes without a protected-token or vault handoff; customer secure reveal remains deferred for such rows.
requiredOwnerWork.requiredEvidence: Secure issuance/reveal through the existing owner boundary, then a real coupon purchase with payment, sale, delivery and purchased-owner evidence before discounted Apparel Checkout. Never pre-apply the campaign or invent coupon ownership.

point2.paymentBoundary: The configured CARD path uses DefaultStripeSandboxAdapterService, an offline simulator with no Stripe network execution. Even a future successful local run qualifies offline conformance only, not credentialed gateway acceptance. No payment execution was reached in this batch.
unexecuted: Purchased coupon checkout and secure reveal
Mandatory campaign quote and one-time Checkout commitment
point2.effects: The canonical runner created its own acceptance Cart/list entries before stopping. No direct database cleanup was performed. Earlier and runner-created records were preserved rather than assuming failure rolled them back.

cartFocusedTests.overlap: Cart API tests also run in Commerce; activated port tests also run in additional suites.
